records.context: The quantity is I(gene; new | old) for Gaussian data: half the log ratio of the determinants of the total and the within-gene covariance of the new columns, both conditioned on the old columns (Schur complements). A column that the old features predict has 0 added bits, and so has noise, up to the null. The unique fraction is 1 - R2 of a column on the old features.
records.label: spacr.ops_feature_info.screen#20
records.source: THE QUANTITY is I(gene; new | old) for Gaussian data: half the log ratio of the determinants of the total and the within-gene covariance of the new columns, both conditioned on the old columns (Schur complements). A column that the old features predict has 0 added bits, and so has noise, up to the null. The unique fraction is 1 - R2 of a column on the old features.
records.translation: STÆRÐIN er I(gen; nýtt | gamalt) fyrir Gauss-gögn: helmingur lógaritmans af hlutfalli ákveða heildarsamdreifni og samdreifni innan gena fyrir nýju dálkana, hvort tveggja skilyrt á gömlu dálkunum (Schur-fyllingar). Dálkur sem gömlu eiginleikarnir spá fyrir um bætir við 0 bitum, og það gerir suð líka, upp að núllinu. Einstaki hlutinn er 1 - R2 dálks á gömlu eiginleikana.

records.context: NULL, held-out and guide checks. The permutations change only the group sums, so they are cheap. Observed minus the null mean is the corrected estimate; the interval is that value +- 1.96 null SDs. The held-out estimate predicts each cell by its gene's mean on the other microplate sample positions. The guide-replicated estimate predicts each cell by the other guides of its gene, against the same predictors given to guides of other genes with as many cells behind them.
records.label: spacr.ops_feature_info.screen#21
records.source: NULL, HELD-OUT AND GUIDE CHECKS. The permutations change only the group sums, so they are cheap. Observed minus the null mean is the corrected estimate; the interval is that value +- 1.96 null SDs. The held-out estimate predicts each cell by its gene's mean on the other wells. The guide-replicated estimate predicts each cell by the other guides of its gene, against the same predictors given to guides of other genes with as many cells behind them.
records.translation: NÚLL, FRÁTEKNAR FRUMUR OG LEIÐARAPRÓFUN. Umraðanirnar breyta aðeins hópasummunum og eru því ódýrar. Mælt mínus meðaltal núllsins er leiðrétta matið; bilið er það gildi +- 1,96 staðalfrávik núllsins. Frátekna matið spáir hverri frumu með meðaltali gens hennar á hinum holunum. Leiðaraendurtekna matið spáir hverri frumu með hinum leiðurum gens hennar, borið saman við sömu spár gefnar leiðurum annarra gena sem byggja á jafnmörgum frumum.
